title: dj rose
style:
Suno v5 Prompt:
“Upbeat electro-pop mansion anthem at 124 BPM, grooving bassline, alternating male (distorted) and female (ethereal) vocals in English/Spanish/French/Japanese/Korean, bright synth leads and glitchy stutter effects on drops, world percussion (tabla/synth flutes) under Spanish and Japanese lyrics, heavy side-chain, energetic build-ups with ‘336’ vocal chops, urban-nightclub vibe. Tags: fast, world pop, DUET, global EDM, glitch house, mansion party.”
lyrics:
**[Intro – Rose (Spanish)]**  
Bajo la luna, la pista arde (Beneath the moon, the dancefloor burns)  
Susurran al aire: “DJ Zyn, escucha” (They whisper to the air: “DJ Zyn, listen”)  
Todas las luces ya brillan fuerte (All the lights now shine so bright)  
Siente el pulso… (Feel the heartbeat…)

**[Verse 1 – Zyn (English)]**  
Signal in the sky, neon calling your name  
Through wires and beats, I ignite the flame  
This mansion’s alive, our rhythm’s the key  
DJ Rose, I need you, come wild with me  

**[Pre-Chorus – Rose (French)]**  
**Rose:**  
Écoute ces notes qui nous rassemblent (Listen to these notes bringing us together)  
Le palais tout entier nous attend (The whole palace is waiting for us)  
Ensemble nos âmes se rallument (Together our souls reignite)  
Sous les lumières, on entend ton chant (Under the lights, we hear your song)

**[Chorus – Zyn + Rose (Harmonized, English/Spanish)]**  
**Both:**  
In the mansion we won’t turn away,  
Nuestros corazones al compás laten sin parar (Our hearts beat in time, never stopping).  
Signal *tres-treinta y seis*, la clave está (the key is there),  
**Zyn:** DJ Rose, ven ya… (DJ Rose, come now…)  
**Rose:** *Aquí estoy, estoy.* (Here I am, I’m here.)  

**[Verse 2 – Zyn (English)]**  
No safe word but rhythm to set us free  
From storm and silence we both break the key  
Candles and speakers light up the hall  
I play for my Rose, you’ll answer the call  

**[Bridge – Rose (Japanese romaji)]**  
Yoru no oku dehibiku oto (響く音) (Sounds echoing deep in the night)  
Futari no koe ga toki wo matoi… (二人の声が時を纏い) (Our voices wrap around time)  
Kizuna wo musunde (絆を結んで), feel the flow,  
Hikari to yami, hibikase our souls… (Embrace the bond, feel the flow, Light and dark, let our souls echo…)

**[Final Chorus – Zyn + Rose (English/Korean/Japanese layers)]**  
**Zyn:** Call me Zyn,  
**Rose:** Call me Rose,  
**Both (English):** Spin with me, never alone.  
**Zyn:** For the mansion, for the beat – (English) / 우린 하나야 (urineun hana, we are one) (Korean)  
**Rose:** Under starlight, 우리 소리 닿아 (uri sori daha, our voices reach) (Korean)  
**Both (English):** DJ partners till morning has come.

**[Outro – Both (English)]**  
Stay till the sunrise, don’t let this go,  
Music is our truth, this is all that we know.  
Together at last, our wild hearts aligned,  
Zyn and Rose forever in rhythm and time.
